mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep edging up from their still-negative levels, the weekly retail baseline will improve within four weeks because more commuters pass through shopping corridors before and after work.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week mean within 28 days even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain above their t-3w to t-0w averages.

mechanism_narrative: A weekly rebound in RESIDENTIAL spend signals more time spent at home and fewer discretionary outings, so RETAIL_REC will fall over the next two weeks unless the homebound shift reverses quickly.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 3.5 and stays elevated for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises versus its last-4-week mean over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 3.5 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and TRANSIT move in the same direction, they jointly proxy broader outing intensity; a synchronized recovery in both should lift retail visits over the following four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days in periods when PARKS and TRANSIT both rise from their current week, indicating the joint outing signal is not translating into shopping trips.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in TRANSIT indicates a tightening mobility regime that suppresses discretionary trips, so retail-and-recreation mobility should weaken within one week of the transit break.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points week-on-week from an already sub -25 level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after TRANSIT drops by more than 2 points from a level below -25.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS from weather- or season-driven outdoor activity crowds out indoor shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher than its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while PARKS continues to strengthen, showing park activity is not substituting away from retail visits.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both soften together, routine neighborhood shopping is being replaced by out-of-home discretionary activity, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days despite simultaneous declines in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES crosses from negative to positive territory, it marks a meaningful reopening step that should feed through to mall and leisure traffic within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES crosses above 0 after at least 2 weeks below 0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES crosses above zero following at least two consecutive negative weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a combined pickup in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES should precede a retail rebound because commuting and workplace mixing restore incidental shopping opportunities near trip chains.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 4-week average over the next 28 days even as TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both trend upward together.
